decision_conditions: The amendment to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application;
1.	Alterations to proposed rear facade - change from bi-folding doors to rear window and French style double doors and window panels to the approved rear extension.

The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and annotated on drawing numbers of MON-0725-254 Rev. B and MON-0725-256 Rev. B and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings. Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P1111.25.
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission ref: P1111.25 dated 21/10/2025 to allow for an alteration to proposed rear facade - change from bi-folding doors to rear window and French style double doors and window panels to the approved rear extension (Single storey rear extension and alterations to fenestration)
